name: Recall
tagline: A wearable memory assistant that summarises your day and recognises the people you love.

awards: Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI
Best Use of Arm by MLH

problem: People with Alzheimer's or dementia lose track of daily events and faces.
solution: A Raspberry Pi camera captures significant moments, an LLM summarises them into a daily timeline, and face recognition identifies loved ones.
demo_moment: Team-described: review the day's timeline and see a recognised face labelled.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI” and “Best Use of Arm by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Aims at identity and independence for patients.

lessons: Wearable memory aids need consent design for bystanders.
